thread:
maya: @derek escalating — StreamlineFX onboarding blocked: SSO callback failing for ~80% of invites. They go live in 9 days, customer paused rollout. flagging renewal-risk, please prioritize.

derek: ack. can you paste the exact error + repro steps? also which tenants/org IDs affected?

maya: pasted steps in thread and attached sample log: "InvalidRedirectUri" at callback, upstream 504 around callback window. repro on their env id `org_4572`. manual admin-invite works intermittently (5% success).

arjun: assigning to eng oncall. @ben can you take a look at callback service? sounds like session/store or proxy issue after last night's auth deploy.

ben: looking now. saw a deploy at 00:32 that touched auth-proxy routing. starting rollback to v2.3.8. will post status.

ops-bot: JIRA created: CS-1458 StreamlineFX SSO onboarding failure https://jira.company/CS-1458

derek: comms plan idea: immediate customer note acknowledging, say we're rolling back and validating in 30m, provide manual invite workaround. maya — can you DM the customer operations email list?

maya: added repro + logs to CS-1458, DMed onboarding@streamlinefx.com with temporary invite steps. also included `curl` test snippet for support:```
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.example/callback -d 'redirect_uri=https://app.streamlinefx.com/sso/callback' -v
```

elaine: cc: support-leads. if not resolved in 60m we should prepare an exec update. renewal risk now elevated — loop AMs.

derek: agreed. i'll prepare exec note template and a goodwill offer (free enablement session) if rollout is delayed. scheduling checkpoint at T+45m.

arjun: rollback complete, metrics look better. callback 200s returned to baseline. still seeing some 429 from our rate limiter for that org, increasing org-level rate limit temporarily to unblock onboarding.

maya: verified manual invite + SSO flow for sample users — successful for test org `org_4572`. pushing update to customer now.

derek: marking this P0 -> renewal-risk. opening renewal playbook and notifying renewals manager.

ben: leaving note: deploy fully reverted, but we'll run a deeper postmortem. creating ENG-7890 for root cause + test harness. expected RCA by EOD.

maya: customer asked for ETA on root cause. can we promise a time?

ben: RCA draft by EOD today, full report tomorrow morning. mitigation and test results will be attached.

derek: summary/action items: (1) CS exec note to customer (derek) (2) Eng RCA (ben / ENG-7890) (3) Support follow-up with logs + repro (maya) (4) Offer enablement session + schedule if needed (derek) (5) Monitor 24h and revert rate limit after stability (arjun). I'll update CS-1458 with assignees. :thumbsup:

jira-bot: Linked issues: ENG-7890, CS-1458, ONB-102

maya: customer accepted workaround and will continue provisioning users. i'll keep thread updated on any reoccurrence.

derek: thanks team — great quick coordination. we'll use this for the renewal check-in notes and make sure AMs have the timeline.
